regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 78". Whistler follows.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Baker is forecast for about 44", 25" of it Thursday. Crystal Mountain and Stevens Pass follow.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 22", 13" of it Saturday. Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: RED Mountain is forecast for about 13", 9" of it Thursday. Whitewater and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Palisades is forecast for about 10". Sugar Bowl and Sierra-at-Tahoe follow. The NWS is calling for more at Palisades: 8 to 17 inches Sunday through Wednesday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 8", 4" of it Monday. Breckenridge and Aspen Highlands follow.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 6", 3" of it Thursday. Sun Peaks and SilverStar follow.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
